title: Container Bookings: customer roll allowance, limit and fee by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, how many customer-caused rolls a booking may have without fee, the most customer-caused rolls one booking may have before it must be cancelled and rebooked, and the fee for a customer-caused roll beyond the free allowance.

## What each setting means
- **Free customer rolls**: customer-caused rolls per booking without fee.
- **Customer roll limit**: the maximum customer-caused rolls on one booking before it must be cancelled and rebooked.
- **Customer roll fee**: the fee for a customer-caused roll beyond the free allowance, in USD per container.

## Tier table
| Tier | Free customer rolls | Customer roll limit | Customer roll fee (USD per container) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0 | 1 | 150.00 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 1 | 2 | 100.00 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 1 | 3 | 75.00 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 2 | 3 | 50.00 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 0 | 1 | 120.00 |
| AHL Premium Express | 1 | 2 | 100.00 |

## Points of judgement
**Which tiers have no free customer roll?** AHL Spot Saver and AHL Guaranteed Loading, whose free allowance is 0 and whose limit is 1.

**Where is the widest room between free rolls and the limit?** AHL Contract Booking, with 1 free roll and a limit of 3.
